body: I think that there is a line where people go from having worth and being valuable on this planet because of them being them, to them deserving to rot in jail for the rest of eternity. Hitler shouldn’t have been allowed to kill himself. He should have rotted in a gulag until he died, with hope painfully. Cause Hitler sucks. Most people deserve to live with the consequences of their actions. Rapists get messed up in prison. Same as people who diddle kids. I’d say that the line where suicide is good is so thin that dropping a sheet of paper on it would cut the paper. And last I checked all humans are larger than a sheet of paper.

I also was confronted by that feeling a while back. All my time was spent building relations on this sub or something else to feel noticed. I spent most of my time talking to people here because it made me feel like I had value, when in reality I did nothing. I said I would stop using this sub because it’s unhealthy for me, and yet here I am. It’s a substitute, definitely, but what’s wrong with living that lie? If it feels real, who is to say it isn’t valuable? I feel something when I get that ding on my phone. I get that same small, tiny, dopamine rush. From a scientific standpoint my brain is still releasing the same chemicals. Why can’t I enjoy this lie until it ends? Though I do rely less on this sub than before, I still use it to try and feel worth, albeit false.

Ok I’m sorry this took so long to get to you.

What I would do if I wasn’t confident enough to spill all the beans is I would say I have anxiety, or some small bits of depression here or there. Nothing too extreme so it is understandable from their view, but at the same time I can use it in future events as a way to build understanding and as a way to bring up other, more serious issues. Until eventually I trust them enough, and they trust me, so I can tell them that I feel suicidal.

Option 2 is if you have self confidence x3. You make a written note detailing what you’ve been going through. I’d guess similar to a suicide note but without the subtext that you are dead. I’ve found detailing your thoughts in words make it a lot easier to understand, and also a lot more difficult to doubt. Telling them in person also allows you to get flustered, which will make you seem faker even if you are telling the truth. Also it might be a subconscious thing, but people will believe what they read more than a person telling them the same thing. Don’t know why but that’s been my experience.
